# ColorSwatches

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:color-swatches` · Kerf UI · component · Controls

A fixed palette: a native radio group of round color swatches with no visible text, each named by its color, the chosen one ringed independently of hue, with a struck-through no-color swatch, compact size, and disabled state.

## When to use

Let a person choose one color from a small fixed palette (a label, tag, or command color), or no color.

- A setting takes one color from a small, curated palette (a label, calendar, or command color): render ColorSwatches with name, a label, swatches, and value, and read the choice on change.
- No color is a valid choice: include a swatch with color 'transparent'.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it when any color is allowed; use a ColorPicker or ColorField.
- Do not use it for choices that are not colors; use ChoiceChips or a RadioGroup.
- Do not put text in the swatches; the color's label names each one.

**Alternatives:**

- [ChoiceChips](./choice-chips.md) (nearest) — Use ChoiceChips with swatches when each color also needs a visible name.
- [RadioGroup](./radio-group.md) (nearest) — Use a RadioGroup for choices that are not colors.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/color-swatches` — exports `ColorSwatches`, `ColorSwatchesProps`, `ColorSwatch`, `ColorSwatchesSize`, `ColorSwatchesRootAttributes`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/color-swatches` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/color-swatches.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/color-swatches`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicolor-swatches) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- fixed palette with a visible label
- a no-color swatch
- compact size
- disabled
- ariaLabel without a visible label

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the palette and its color names; the chosen value (read it on change through action); the field name and form association.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: controls). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The group takes the shared block-content inset (a transparent 1px border and 8px padding), so its label sits on the text column; each swatch keeps 4px of room for its ring, pulled back at the row's edges.

## Accessibility

- It is a native radio group: Tab reaches it once and the arrow keys move the choice; each radio is named by its color label, also shown as the swatch's hover hint.
- The chosen swatch wears a ring in the text color set off by a gap, so the choice never depends on hue; forced colors draw it in Highlight.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-color-swatches`, `kui-color-swatches__label`, `kui-color-swatches__list`, `kui-color-swatches__swatch`, `kui-color-swatches__input`, `kui-color-swatches__dot`.

Never put `kui-color-swatches`, `kui-color-swatches__label`, `kui-color-swatches__list`, `kui-color-swatches__swatch`, `kui-color-swatches__input`, `kui-color-swatches__dot` on an element you write; render `ColorSwatches` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
